sql.where:
AND achievement_link.entity_id IS NULL
AND LOCATE( LOWER(#{query.title}), LOWER(COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(title_override.field_value), a.title_normalized)) ) > 0
AND a.id IN (SELECT matched_author.achievement_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.achievement_id) AS achievement_id FROM achievement_author aa LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = aa.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = aa.author_id JOIN author au ON au.id = COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.author_id) WHERE LOCATE(LOWER(#{query.author}), LOWER(au.display_name)) > 0 ) matched_author)
AND a.id IN (SELECT matched_organization.achievement_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.achievement_id) AS achievement_id FROM authorship_organization ao LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = ao.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link organization_link ON organization_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND organization_link.entity_id = ao.organization_id JOIN organization o ON o.id = COALESCE(organization_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.organization_id) WHERE (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query.organization}), LOWER(o.display_name)) > 0 OR o.id IN ( SELECT COALESCE(alias_link.canonical_entity_id, evidence.organization_id) FROM organization_name_evidence evidence LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link alias_link ON alias_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND alias_link.entity_id = evidence.organization_id WHERE LOCATE(LOWER(#{query.organization}), LOWER(evidence.display_name)) > 0 )) ) matched_organization)
AND YEAR(COALESCE( STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), '%Y-%m-%d'), a.publication_date )) = #{query.publicationYear}
AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(type_override.field_value), a.achievement_type) = #{query.achievementType}
AND a.id IN (SELECT matched_source.achievement_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, axs.achievement_id) AS achievement_id FROM achievement_source axs JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id = axs.source_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = axs.achievement_id WHERE ds.source_code = #{query.sourceCode} ) matched_source)
AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{query.venue}), LOWER(v.display_name)) > 0
AND a.id IN (SELECT matched_topic.achievement_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ats.achievement_id) AS achievement_id FROM achievement_subject ats JOIN subject subject_value ON subject_value.id = ats.subject_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = ats.achievement_id WHERE LOCATE(LOWER(#{query.topic}), LOWER(subject_value.display_name)) > 0 ) matched_topic)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM achievement_author x LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = x.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link related_link ON related_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND related_link.entity_id = x.author_id WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, x.achievement_id) = a.id AND COALESCE(related_link.canonical_entity_id, x.author_id) = #{relatedId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM authorship_organization x LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = x.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link related_link ON related_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND related_link.entity_id = x.organization_id WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, x.achievement_id) = a.id AND COALESCE(related_link.canonical_entity_id, x.organization_id) = #{relatedId} )
AND COALESCE(venue_link.canonical_entity_id, effective_venue.id) = #{relatedId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM achievement_subject x LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = x.achievement_id WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, x.achievement_id) = a.id AND x.subject_id = #{relatedId} )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievement a LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN manual_field_override title_override ON title_override.achievement_id = a.id AND title_override.field_name = 'title' AND title_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override type_override ON type_override.achievement_id = a.id AND type_override.field_name = 'type' AND type_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override date_override ON date_override.achievement_id = a.id AND date_override.field_name = 'publicationDate' AND date_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override venue_override ON venue_override.achievement_id = a.id AND venue_override.field_name = 'venueId' AND venue_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN venue effective_venue ON effective_venue.id = COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(venue_override.field_value) AS UNSIGNED), a.primary_venue_id) LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link venue_link ON venue_link.entity_type = 'VENUE' AND venue_link.entity_id = effective_venue.id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.id = COALESCE(venue_link.canonical_entity_id, effective_venue.id)

SELECT a.id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(title_override.field_value), a.title_original) AS title, a.doi_normalized AS doi, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(type_override.field_value), a.achievement_type) AS achievement_type, COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), '%Y-%m-%d'), a.publication_date) AS publication_date, v.display_name AS primary_venue FROM achievement a LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN manual_field_override title_override ON title_override.achievement_id = a.id AND title_override.field_name = 'title' AND title_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override type_override ON type_override.achievement_id = a.id AND type_override.field_name = 'type' AND type_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override date_override ON date_override.achievement_id = a.id AND date_override.field_name = 'publicationDate' AND date_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override venue_override ON venue_override.achievement_id = a.id AND venue_override.field_name = 'venueId' AND venue_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN venue effective_venue ON effective_venue.id = COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(venue_override.field_value) AS UNSIGNED), a.primary_venue_id) LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link venue_link ON venue_link.entity_type = 'VENUE' AND venue_link.entity_id = effective_venue.id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.id = COALESCE(venue_link.canonical_entity_id, effective_venue.id)
ORDER BY a.publication_date DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(title_override.field_value), a.title_original) AS title, a.doi_normalized AS doi, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(type_override.field_value), a.achievement_type) AS achievement_type, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(language_override.field_value), a.language) AS language, COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), '%Y-%m-%d'), a.publication_date) AS publication_date, v.display_name AS primary_venue, pd.abstract_text, COALESCE(pd.authorships_may_be_incomplete, FALSE) AS authorships_may_be_incomplete FROM achievement requested LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link requested_link ON requested_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND requested_link.entity_id = requested.id JOIN achievement a ON a.id = COALESCE(requested_link.canonical_entity_id, requested.id) LEFT JOIN manual_field_override title_override ON title_override.achievement_id = a.id AND title_override.field_name = 'title' AND title_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override type_override ON type_override.achievement_id = a.id AND type_override.field_name = 'type' AND type_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override language_override ON language_override.achievement_id = a.id AND language_override.field_name = 'language' AND language_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override date_override ON date_override.achievement_id = a.id AND date_override.field_name = 'publicationDate' AND date_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override venue_override ON venue_override.achievement_id = a.id AND venue_override.field_name = 'venueId' AND venue_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN venue effective_venue ON effective_venue.id = COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(venue_override.field_value) AS UNSIGNED), a.primary_venue_id) LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link venue_link ON venue_link.entity_type = 'VENUE' AND venue_link.entity_id = effective_venue.id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.id = COALESCE(venue_link.canonical_entity_id, effective_venue.id) LEFT JOIN paper_detail pd ON pd.achievement_id = a.id WHERE requested.id = #{id}

SELECT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, au.id AS entity_id, au.display_name, openalex.external_id, orcid.external_id AS orcid, MIN(aa.author_position) AS position FROM achievement_author aa LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = aa.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = aa.author_id JOIN author au ON au.id = COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.author_id) LEFT JOIN author_external_id openalex ON openalex.author_id = au.id AND openalex.id_type = 'OPENALEX' LEFT JOIN author_external_id orcid ON orcid.author_id = au.id AND orcid.id_type = 'ORCID' WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.achievement_id) IN #{id} GROUP BY COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.achievement_id), au.id, au.display_name, openalex.external_id, orcid.external_id ORDER BY achievement_id, position, au.id

SELECT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ats.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, subject_value.id AS entity_id, subject_value.external_id, subject_value.display_name, MIN(ats.subject_position) AS position FROM achievement_subject ats LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = ats.achievement_id JOIN subject subject_value ON subject_value.id = ats.subject_id WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ats.achievement_id) IN #{id} GROUP BY COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ats.achievement_id), subject_value.id, subject_value.external_id, subject_value.display_name ORDER BY achievement_id, position, subject_value.id

SELECT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, canonical_author.id AS entity_id, o.id AS organization_id, o.openalex_id AS organization_external_id, o.display_name AS organization_name FROM authorship_organization ao LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = ao.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = ao.author_id JOIN author canonical_author ON canonical_author.id = COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.author_id) LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link organization_link ON organization_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND organization_link.entity_id = ao.organization_id JOIN organization o ON o.id = COALESCE(organization_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.organization_id) WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.achievement_id) = #{id} GROUP BY COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.achievement_id), canonical_author.id, o.id, o.openalex_id, o.display_name ORDER BY canonical_author.id, o.id

SELECT axs.id, axs.raw_record_id, ds.source_code, axs.external_record_id, axs.source_url, axs.parser_version, axs.first_seen_at, axs.last_seen_at, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot.normalized_payload, '$.scholarlyMetadata') AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS scholarly_metadata FROM achievement_source axs JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id = axs.source_id LEFT JOIN achievement_source_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.achievement_source_id = axs.id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = axs.achievement_id WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, axs.achievement_id) = #{id} ORDER BY ds.source_code, axs.external_record_id, axs.id

SELECT reference_value.referenced_external_work_id FROM achievement_reference reference_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = reference_value.citing_achievement_id WHERE COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, reference_value.citing_achievement_id) = #{id} GROUP BY reference_value.referenced_external_work_id ORDER BY referenced_external_work_id

SELECT provenance.field_name, source.source_code, provenance.raw_record_id, FALSE AS manual_override FROM entity_field_provenance provenance JOIN data_source source ON source.id = provenance.source_id WHERE provenance.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND provenance.entity_id = #{id} AND provenance.selected = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT field_name, NULL, NULL, TRUE FROM manual_field_override WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY field_name, manual_override DESC

SELECT evidence.display_name, source.source_code, MIN(evidence.first_observed_at) AS first_observed_at, MAX(evidence.last_observed_at) AS last_observed_at FROM organization_name_evidence evidence JOIN data_source source ON source.id = evidence.source_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link entity_link ON entity_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND entity_link.entity_id = evidence.organization_id WHERE COALESCE(entity_link.canonical_entity_id, evidence.organization_id) = #{entityId} GROUP BY evidence.name_hash, evidence.display_name, source.source_code ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, source.source_code, evidence.name_hash LIMIT 101

SELECT organization.id AS organization_id, organization.display_name, MIN(YEAR(COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), '%Y-%m-%d'), a.publication_date))) AS first_publication_year, MAX(YEAR(COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), '%Y-%m-%d'), a.publication_date))) AS last_publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS achievement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(date_override.field_value, a.publication_date) IS NOT NULL THEN a.id END) AS dated_achievement_count FROM authorship_organization relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = relation_value.author_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link organization_link ON organization_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND organization_link.entity_id = relation_value.organization_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id JOIN organization ON organization.id = COALESCE(organization_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.organization_id) JOIN achievement a ON a.id = COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) LEFT JOIN manual_field_override date_override ON date_override.achievement_id = a.id AND date_override.field_name = 'publicationDate' AND date_override.active = TRUE WHERE COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.author_id) = #{entityId} GROUP BY organization.id, organization.display_name ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, organization.id LIMIT 101

sql.if: AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(e.display_name)) > 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_name_evidence evidence LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link alias_link ON alias_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND alias_link.entity_id = evidence.organization_id WHERE COALESCE(alias_link.canonical_entity_id, evidence.organization_id) = e.id AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(evidence.display_name)) > 0 ))

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author e LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link entity_link ON entity_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND entity_link.entity_id = e.id WHERE entity_link.entity_id IS NULL AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(e.display_name)) > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization e LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link entity_link ON entity_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND entity_link.entity_id = e.id WHERE entity_link.entity_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM venue e LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link entity_link ON entity_link.entity_type = 'VENUE' AND entity_link.entity_id = e.id WHERE entity_link.entity_id IS NULL AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(e.display_name)) > 0
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subject e WHERE LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(e.display_name)) > 0

mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, openalex.external_id, e.display_name, 'AUTHOR' AS entity_type, COUNT(DISTINCT relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_count FROM author e LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link entity_link ON entity_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND entity_link.entity_id = e.id LEFT JOIN author_external_id openalex ON openalex.author_id = e.id AND openalex.id_type = 'OPENALEX' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.author_id) AS entity_id, COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, aa.achievement_id) AS achievement_id FROM achievement_author aa LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = aa.author_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = aa.achievement_id ) relation_value ON relation_value.entity_id = e.id WHERE entity_link.entity_id IS NULL AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(e.display_name)) > 0 GROUP BY e.id, openalex.external_id, e.display_name
SELECT e.id, e.openalex_id AS external_id, e.display_name, e.organization_type AS entity_type, COUNT(DISTINCT relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_count FROM organization e LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link entity_link ON entity_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND entity_link.entity_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(organization_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.organization_id) AS entity_id, COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, ao.achievement_id) AS achievement_id FROM authorship_organization ao LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link organization_link ON organization_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND organization_link.entity_id = ao.organization_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = ao.achievement_id ) relation_value ON relation_value.entity_id = e.id WHERE entity_link.entity_id IS NULL
GROUP BY e.id, e.openalex_id, e.display_name, e.organization_type
SELECT e.id, e.openalex_id AS external_id, e.display_name, e.venue_type AS entity_type, COUNT(DISTINCT relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_count FROM venue e LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link entity_link ON entity_link.entity_type = 'VENUE' AND entity_link.entity_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(venue_link.canonical_entity_id, a.primary_venue_id) AS entity_id, COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, a.id) AS achievement_id FROM achievement a LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link venue_link ON venue_link.entity_type = 'VENUE' AND venue_link.entity_id = a.primary_venue_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = a.id ) relation_value ON relation_value.entity_id = e.id WHERE entity_link.entity_id IS NULL AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(e.display_name)) > 0 GROUP BY e.id, e.openalex_id, e.display_name, e.venue_type
SELECT e.id, e.external_id, e.display_name, 'TOPIC' AS entity_type, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, atp.achievement_id)) AS achievement_count FROM subject e LEFT JOIN achievement_subject atp ON atp.subject_id = e.id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = atp.achievement_id WHERE LOCATE(LOWER(#{name}), LOWER(e.display_name)) > 0 GROUP BY e.id, e.external_id, e.display_name
ORDER BY display_name, id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
